skills.name: docs-expert
skills.description: Expert in agile, precise, and strategic software project documentation. Covers READMEs,   architecture docs, API/data-model docs, code conventions, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs),   functional specifications, business rules, and stakeholder-facing decision documents. Keeps   documentation lightweight and living (updated alongside the code, never a stale one-off), and   enforces a strict separation between TECHNICAL documentation and BUSINESS/FUNCTIONAL documentation   so each audience gets exactly what it needs without duplication.   Trigger: When the user says "documenta", "documentación", "escribe un ADR", "documento de decisión",   "readme", "especificación funcional", "reglas de negocio", "documento técnico", "documenta la   arquitectura", "documenta la api", "actualiza la documentación", "document this", "write a README",   "write an ADR", "architecture decision record", "functional spec", "business rules doc",   "decision document", "document the architecture", "document the API", "update the docs", or any   variant expressing intent to create or maintain documentation for a software project.
